## Example data (synthetic)

**Everything in this folder is artificial.** It was generated by `geoxplain.datasets.make_synthetic_geodata` (smooth random fields plus a documented generating process) and does **not** represent real observations, places or phenomena. The CRS `EPSG:32645` is used only to give the grid realistic metric coordinates.

Regenerate at any time (seeded, deterministic):

```bash
geoxplain generate-data --out-dir data --size 100 --n-samples 2500 --seed 42
```

| Path | Content |
|---|---|
| `samples.csv` | training table: `id, x, y, ndvi, ndbi, lst, elevation, rainfall, distance_to_water, population, target, susceptibility_index, landcover` |
| `stack.tif` | 7-band predictor stack (band descriptions = feature names) on a 100 x 100 grid, 30 m cells |
| `rasters/<feature>.tif` | the same predictors as single-band GeoTIFFs |
| `truth/*.tif` | the true generating probability and targets (for inspection/verification only) |
| `dataset_metadata.json` | disclaimer, parameters, generating coefficients, column descriptions |

Targets: `target` (binary event indicator, classification demo), `susceptibility_index` (continuous 0-100, regression demo), `landcover` (string classes, multi-class demo). **Never use the target columns other than the one you model as features.**
